277786458.description:
Ancient & Historical Artifact Lot
Stone Projectile Points and Clay Pipe Fragments
17 Items, Mixed Age and Origin
This collection features a diverse assortment of lithic artifacts and historical clay pipe components. The stone pieces display varying degrees of bifacial flaking, pressure flaking, and retouching across multiple chert and flint varieties. The inclusion of early clay pipe fragments suggests a broad chronological range, potentially spanning from prehistoric indigenous cultures to historical-era trade goods.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Large Chert Blade
- Light grey chert with significant bifacial thinning and shaped edge.
2.
Projectile Points (14)
- Assorted sizes and styles including side-notched, corner-notched, and stemmed bases in grey, tan, and reddish-brown stone.
3.
Reeded Clay Pipe Bowl
- Terracotta-colored clay with vertical fluting or reeded decorative pattern.
4.
Clay Pipe Stem Fragment
- Smooth, curved section of a clay pipe stem in similar terracotta-toned material.
Materials: Chert, flint, and fired clay
Construction: Knapped stone tools; molded and fired ceramics
Dimensions: Approximately 6" x 4" x 3" lot footprint (provided)
Condition:
Mixed artifact condition. Stone points show expected weathering and varying degrees of edge wear; some tips or bases may show ancient or modern breaks consistent with find-site artifacts. Clay pipe fragments are incomplete sections (bowl and stem). Surface patina and soil staining present throughout consistent with excavated or field-found materials.
